_comment: TODO(IT-AUTH): synthetic/demo passwords for REQ-RDT-NAV-08's Login page ONLY — NOT real credentials, NOT the real employee/user table (see SRS.md section 3.7 open question). Kept in a SEPARATE file from employee-directory.seed.json on purpose: GET /api/directory already publicly lists every entry in that file (used for the @mention autocomplete), so a password living in the same object would leak through that endpoint. Password scheme, chosen for 'easy to remember while testing', not real password policy: lowercase(dinas code) + '123' for PIC entries (e.g. dinas TB -> 'tb123'); 'tab123' for the TAB-wide role (SM_TA/GH_TA removed entirely 24 Jul, project owner correction — role TAB now handles everything they used to). Username = the same key used elsewhere as the directory user_id/X-User-Id value.
